name: How do I choose the right contractor for an interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a contractor with extensive residential experience, appropriate insurance and bonding, active workers' compensation coverage, and clear communication practices. Ask about their ability to manage both structural work and fine finishing touches, such as tile and drywall. It is also beneficial to verify if they offer transparent project management and upfront estimates. Clear oversight from planning through final walk-through ensures your renovation finishes as expected.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured, and bonded contractor with verifiable experience, strong communication, dedicated project oversight, and clear, itemized estimates.
